comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Advance the recovery record with an accepted convergence base**

When a GitHub-issue matrix is prepared at A and `origin/development` advances to B through history accepted by `verifyMatrixConvergenceAdvance`, convergence deliberately executes and records the cycle at B (`main.ts:4772-4778`), but `reuseMatrixPreparedRecoveryRecord` retains A and `persistCandidateRecoveryPhase` never copies the checkpoint record's new `base_sha`. The recovery report therefore remains at A even after a successful checkpoint, so this equality check makes pre-push and the always-run delivery reconciliation reject every such otherwise-valid converged candidate. Update the durable recovery record to B after proving the advance, rather than weakening the identity check.
